subject: general
question: What are ribosomes made up of?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Proteins and RNA**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ribosomes are made up of both proteins and RNA**
 
• These** two components combine to form two subunits – a large subunit and a small subunit **– which together make a functional ribosome.
 
• Ribosomal **RNA plays a crucial role in the ribosome's structure and function.**
 
• It **helps in catalyzing the formation of peptide bonds, acting as a ribozyme,** which is essential for protein synthesis.
 
• **Ribosomal proteins provide structural support **and aid in the proper folding of rRNA.
 
• They also assist in assembling the ribosomal subunits and facilitating their interaction with messenger RNA (mRNA) and transfer RNA (tRNA) during protein synthesis.
 
• Ribosomes are the **site of protein synthesis** in the cell.
